issues.problem: This is a regression from the C-03 fix. The grow crop sets overflow:hidden on the cropped SVG, so any label that ran a little past the phone viewBox's right edge is now cut off mid-word. Before the crop, those labels spilled into the sheet padding. In fig-6b the clipping starts with the follow-up grow. In fig-3c the step-2 reply box loses its right border.
issues.fix: In the phone layouts, pull these labels inside the viewBox (shorten to 'resize at CDN', wrap the upload_url line, narrow the reply box). Alternatively, crop only the height: use a clip-path on the bottom edge instead of overflow:hidden, so horizontal spill stays visible.
